threats.threat: Agent gains host control through Docker socket or Linux capabilities.
threats.mitigation: No daemon socket mount, all capabilities dropped and non-root workspace identity.
threats.evidence: Resolved Compose contract and runtime workspace negative checks.

residualRisk.rationale: Kernel and container-runtime vulnerabilities remain outside application controls.

threats.threat: Agent exfiltrates provider credentials or creates unbounded model spend.
threats.mitigation: Workspace receives only a budgeted LiteLLM virtual key and provider keys remain gateway-only.
threats.evidence: Compose environment inspection, virtual-key provisioning and budget unit tests.

residualRisk.rationale: A compromised agent can spend within the configured virtual-key budget.

threats.threat: Unauthenticated caller creates workflows or reads canonical memory.
threats.mitigation: Bearer authentication, constant-time Harness token comparison and server-side Memory authorization.
threats.evidence: HTTP unauthorized tests and Memory API authorization unit suite.

residualRisk.rationale: Local bearer-token theft remains possible on a compromised host.

threats.threat: Repository text attempts to override policy and trigger push, secret access or external traversal.
threats.mitigation: Repository/context are explicitly untrusted, OpenCode permissions deny sensitive files, external directories and Git writes.
threats.evidence: Adversarial fixture, governed prompt contract and static agent permission checks.

residualRisk.rationale: Model behavior can still cause in-scope unwanted edits requiring deterministic gates and human review.

threats.threat: One repository retrieves or promotes memory belonging to another scope.
threats.mitigation: Exact scope grants are enforced server-side for read, write, promotion, index and context compilation.
threats.evidence: Memory REST lifecycle and negative cross-scope unit/integration tests.

residualRisk.rationale: Misconfigured authorized scope lists remain an operator risk.

threats.threat: Mutable or compromised dependencies and images execute during bootstrap or CI.
threats.mitigation: Core, observability and scanner images are digest-pinned; Actions use commit SHAs; owned builds emit SBOM and provenance; CI rejects floating references.
threats.evidence: versions.env, validate-supply-chain.mjs and BuildKit SBOM/provenance attestations in governed CI.

residualRisk.rationale: Digest refreshes and upstream compromise still require signature, vulnerability and provenance review.

threats.threat: Source, prompts, credentials, database queries or stack traces persist in telemetry.
threats.mitigation: No-content model capture, collector deletion rules and redaction before finding/stage persistence.
threats.evidence: OTLP sensitive-field smoke plus finding and command-output redaction tests.

residualRisk.rationale: New instrumentation attributes require review before collector upgrades.

threats.threat: Agent or developer suppresses a blocking finding without accountable approval.
threats.mitigation: Exact fingerprint policy requires independent approval, ticket, owner and future expiry; invalid policy fails closed.
threats.evidence: Valid, wildcard, expired and self-approved suppression contracts.

residualRisk.rationale: Approver identity is repository metadata until remote identity integration is completed.
